components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 2.75rem; padding: .65rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #1E2B33; border-radius: .35rem; background: #F2B200; color: #1E2B33; font: 600 .8125rem Overpass, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 150ms ease-out, background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #F7C83A; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #14A3B8; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(.96); }

components.name: Savings Frequency Chart
components.description: Compact in-rail comparison of shuttle options and the calculated optimum.
components.html: <svg class="ds-frequency-chart" viewBox="0 0 120 70"><rect class="ds-bar" x="8" y="25" width="14" height="35"/><rect class="ds-bar ds-bar-recommended" x="30" y="12" width="14" height="48"/></svg>

rules.name: The One Amber Rule
rules.body: Amber appears only on the shuttle route and primary action.

dos: Keep the map as the hero.
Expose every model input with source and confidence.
donts: Do not use generic dashboard cards.
Do not use colour as the sole status signal.
